subject.title: fix: Microsoft Teams streaming keeps chunk after whitespace collapse

question: Should this Microsoft Teams delivery fix wait for a redacted live content capture, or is the exact SDK contract plus focused controller coverage sufficient for this edge case?
rationale: Repository policy requires after-fix real behavior proof for external non-docs PRs, while the available production telemetry intentionally cannot observe streamed content; only a maintainer can authorize accepting contract-level proof instead.

options.title: Require live Teams proof
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until a redacted Teams transcript or recording demonstrates the intact `Next` chunk and clean rewrite fallback.

options.title: Accept contract-level proof
options.body: Explicitly waive live content capture based on the deterministic source reproduction, exact pinned SDK semantics, and focused regression tests.

recommendation.title: Require live Teams proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR blocked until a redacted Teams transcript or recording demonstrates the intact `Next` chunk and clean rewrite fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the current controller boundary and is the strongest available routing candidate for its proof and delivery contract.
